text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I would like to hire your Marlowe for a client event. We would pick it up on 25/05/2027 at 10.30am and bring it back on 27th May 2027 at 6:00 pm. Could you bring it to Brackenridge Manor and collect it from there afterwards? We would like it to be driven by a chauffeur. I have attached my driving licence.

Yours sincerely,
Milo Larkmoor
